answer: Each agent’s influence can be capped by requiring a scarce, nontransferable stake that is gradually earned through useful work and forfeited when independent audits catch collusion. A newcomer cannot gain a mesa of voting power just by minting identities: every fake must separately spend time and resources building reputation, while coordinated fraud risks losing the stake. The velvet onboarding may feel gentle, but audits make a meadow of Sybils costly to maintain.
